描述_EN: the garment is reversible. it is lined with a silk chiffon, the same weight as the patterned 'outside' but in plain lilac. exemplifying the shanghai tang touch, a plain chiffon fastening is sewn on the patterned side, and a patterned one is sewn on the plain 'inside'. in this position it serves more as discreet decoration than as a practical fastening although a similar knot and loop secures the garment at the back of the neck. this top is teamed with a matching pair of trousers. a loop and knot fastening is used here at the side of a woman's summer top. this non-traditional use of a traditional closure is typical of the clothese made by shanghai tang, the brainchild of the hong kong entrepreneur david tang.
描述_ZN: 该服装是可翻转的。 它的内衬是丝质雪纺，与外面的图案重量相同，但是是纯淡紫色的。 体现了上海滩的风格，在有图案的一面缝有普通的雪纺扣，而在普通的 "里面 "缝有图案的扣。 在这个位置，它更多的是作为谨慎的装饰，而不是作为一个实用的扣件，尽管类似的结和环将衣服固定在脖子后面。 这件上衣与一条相配的长裤搭配在一起。 这里的环形和结扣是用在女性夏季上衣的侧面。 这种对传统开襟的非传统使用是上海滩的典型服装，上海滩是香港企业家David Tang的创意之作。
